title: 第3258章 雪魔虫第3257章 霜灵涎
lines: “我找到霜灵涎的位置了！”
听到杀生神女所言，萧诺顿时大喜过望。
萧诺询问道：“在哪？”
杀生神女道：“前面那座山谷！”
萧诺目光看向下方，当即朝着那座山谷飞去。
只见偌大的山谷中，有一座湖。
湖面结着厚厚的冰层。
在那湖面上，趴着密密麻麻的雪魔虫。
雪魔虫有大有小，它们堆在一起，数量非常庞大。
而，最为奇特的是，那些雪魔虫围绕在一株特殊的植物旁边。
那是一株类似于“雪莲”的东西。
远远的望去，那株“雪莲”并非实体，它冒着蓝色的雾气，犹如星河般的柔光环绕在周围，梦幻璀璨，耀眼夺目。
萧诺眸中涌动一抹光亮：“那就是‘霜灵涎’吗？怎么长的跟雪莲一样？”
杀生神女解释：“它是霜灵涎幻化出来的形态！”
萧诺更是惊奇：“不是它原本的样子？”
杀生神女道：“对，霜灵涎本身没有固定的形态，它可以是任何样子，这些雪魔虫聚集在这里，便是为了吸取它的能量！”
说时迟，那时快。
那些聚集在湖面的雪魔虫纷纷朝着萧诺攻来。
数之不尽的雪魔虫铺天盖地，犹如浪潮一样，卷起恐怖的气息冲向萧诺。
萧诺倒也不废话，其手中的杀之道爆发出一片血色气流。
“杀之剑招·万剑朝圣！”
下一秒钟，一道剑气法球冲入雪魔虫的内部。
然后“砰”的一声从中炸开，刹那间，亿万缕剑气犹如开闸泻涛，大肆喷发，铺天盖地的雪魔虫都被剑气所吞噬，被灭杀的支离破碎。
接着，萧诺身形一闪，朝着下方冲去。
雪魔虫从四面八方飞来，萧诺长剑挥动，来一只杀一只，来一群杀一群，只见剑光交错，纵横八方，雪魔虫的尸体簌簌的往下掉落。
蓦地，一只体格庞大雪魔虫飞向萧诺。
这只雪魔虫竟有水缸般大小。
它吸收了很多“霜灵涎”的力量，所以实力比其他的雪魔虫强大太多。
但是，不等它靠近萧诺，只见一只金色大手从萧诺的后方探了过来。
这只金色大手直接把那只体格庞大的雪魔虫给牢牢的抓在了掌中。
然后，大手用力一握。
“砰！”的一声爆响，光波炸开，神力播散，那只雪魔虫被捏爆。
萧诺的身后赫然站着一尊盖世身影。
这尊盖世身影好似上苍的投影，霸气绝伦，君临天下。
跟着，盖世身影继续发起攻击，它单手抬起，掌中汇聚着一道星云风暴。
“一力碎万古！”
盖世身影扬手一挥，那道星云风暴直接被其丢了出去。
星云风暴砸入了雪魔虫的群体中，一声震耳欲聋的轰鸣声响起，山谷上空，金色能量风暴横冲八方，形成扫荡之势。
大片的雪魔虫被轰杀成齑粉。
当然，没击杀一片雪魔虫，就会有一缕能量精气被萧诺所吸收。
不过，雪魔虫带来的能量精气都很微弱，好在它们的数量庞大，这些能量精气汇聚起来，还是有一点规模的。
雪魔虫的数量虽多，但终究是阻挡不了萧诺的步伐。
转眼间，萧诺就来到了结冰的湖面上。
content_en:
"I found the location of Shuang Lingshu!"
Xiao Nuo was overjoyed when he heard what the Killing Goddess said.
Xiao Nuo asked: "Where?"
The Killing Goddess said: "That valley ahead!"
Xiao Nuo looked down and immediately flew towards the valley.
I saw a lake in the huge valley.
The lake is covered with thick ice.
On the lake, there were densely packed snow devil insects.
There are large and small snow devil insects, and they are piled together in huge numbers.
And, the most peculiar thing is that those snow devil insects are surrounding a special plant.
It was something similar to a "snow lotus".
Looking from a distance, the "snow lotus" is not real. It is surrounded by blue mist and soft light like a star. It is dreamy, bright and dazzling.
A flash of light surged in Xiao Nuo's eyes: "Is that the 'Frost Spirit Saliva'? Why does it look like a snow lotus?"
The Killing Goddess explained: "It is the form transformed by the saliva of the frost spirit!"
Xiao Nuo was even more surprised: "Isn't it what it is?"
The Killing Goddess said: "Yes, the Frost Spirit Saliva itself has no fixed form. It can look like anything. These Snow Demonic Insects gather here to absorb its energy!"
It's too late, but it's soon.
The snow demon insects gathered on the lake were attacking Xiao Nuo.
Countless snow demon insects were overwhelming, like a wave, rushing toward Xiao Nuo with a terrifying aura.
Xiao Nuo didn't talk nonsense. The killing method in his hand burst out with a bloody air flow.
"The Killing Sword Move·Ten Thousand Swords Pilgrimage!"
The next second, a sword energy ball rushed into the interior of the Snow Demon Insect.
Then a "bang" sound exploded from it. In an instant, billions of sword energy erupted like a flood, and the overwhelming snow demon insects were swallowed up by the sword energy and killed to pieces.
Then, Xiao Nuo flashed and rushed downwards.
Snow Demonic Insects flew from all directions. Xiao Nuo waved his long sword, killing one by one and killing a group of them. The sword lights were interlaced in all directions, and the corpses of the Snow Demonic Insects fell down.
"Uh-huh!"
Suddenly, a huge snow devil insect flew towards Xiao Nuo.
This snow devil insect is as big as a water tank.
It has absorbed a lot of the power of "frost spirit saliva", so it is much stronger than other snow demon insects.
However, before it could get closer to Xiao Nuo, a big golden hand was seen reaching out from behind Xiao Nuo.
This big golden hand directly grasped the huge snow devil insect firmly in its palm.
Then, he shook it hard with his big hand.
"Bang!" There was an explosion, light waves exploded, divine power spread, and the snow demon insect was crushed.
Behind Xiao Nuo stood a peerless figure.
This unparalleled figure is like a projection from the sky, extremely domineering and domineering over the world.
Then, the peerless figure continued to attack. It raised one hand, and a nebula storm gathered in its palm.
"Crush eternity with one force!"
The peerless figure waved his hand, and the nebula storm was directly thrown out by him.
The nebula storm smashed into the group of snow demon insects, and a deafening roar sounded. Over the valley, the golden energy storm swept in all directions, forming a sweeping force.
Large swaths of snow demon insects were bombarded and turned into powder.
Of course, before killing a single snow demon insect, there will be a ray of energy absorbed by Xiao Nuo.
However, the energy essence brought by the Snow Devil Insects is very weak. Fortunately, their number is huge. When these energy essences are gathered together, they can still have a certain scale.
Although the number of snow devil insects was large, they could not stop Xiao Nuo's pace after all.
In the blink of an eye, Xiao Nuo arrived on the frozen lake.
title_en: Chapter 3258 Snow Demonic Insect Chapter 3257 Frost Spirit Saliva
